objectives.description: Enumerate 22 target dirs and confirm exactly one valid .md each
objectives.note: Enumeration surfaced 2 discrepancies from the plan's premise: troelstra_schwichtenberg_2000 has ZERO valid .md (only a quarantined .md.rejected) and must be excluded like gabbay_2000/negri_von_plato_2001; thomas_2003_reactive has TWO valid .md files (ch01, ch03), not one, requiring baier_katoen_2008-style distinct-subdirectory chunking to avoid chunks.json clobber.

Deviation: chunk thomas_2003_reactive's 2 files into distinct .chunks/<name>/ subdirs sharing --doc-id thomas_2003_reactive (baier_katoen_2008-style)
Single literature-build-index.sh --global rebuild after all chunk calls
Spot-check chunks_data count > 0 for all 21 covered dirs

deviations.description: troelstra_schwichtenberg_2000 backfill (originally listed as 1 of the 22 single-file targets)
deviations.reason: Live corpus inspection found only a quarantined proof_theory_lectures.md.rejected in this dir (no valid .md, and no index.json entry exists for it either) — the plan's premise that all 22 listed dirs have exactly one valid .md did not hold for this one. Treated identically to gabbay_2000/negri_von_plato_2001: correctly excluded, not force-chunked.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: skipped — no valid .md, only .md.rejected; treated as a 3rd correctly-excluded dir alongside gabbay_2000/negri_von_plato_2001)*

deviations.description: thomas_2003_reactive backfill (originally listed as 1 of the 22 single-file targets, single literature-chunk.sh call)
deviations.reason: Live corpus inspection found TWO valid .md files (ch01, ch03) in this dir, not one. A single flat literature-chunk.sh call per additional file would have overwritten chunks.json (literature-chunk.sh writes in mode 'w'), clobbering the first chapter — the same hazard Phase 3 mitigates for baier_katoen_2008. Applied the identical distinct-subdirectory technique (chunk each file into sources/thomas_2003_reactive/.chunks/<name>/, sharing --doc-id thomas_2003_reactive) instead of a single top-level chunk call.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — 2 valid .md files found, not 1; used baier_katoen_2008-style distinct-subdir chunking to avoid clobber)*
